findings.title: Public functions renamed/moved without updating other importers or tests
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `SimpleCheckIn` and the failure-status maps were removed from `mark_failed.py`. The PR changes only four files, so any other importers, such as tests that patch `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence` or import `get_failure_reason`, will hit ImportError or patch the wrong target. Patched mocks would also silently stop intercepting calls, because the function is now resolved in `incidents.py`. Search the repo for remaining references and update them, or re-export the old names.

findings.title: Copied config is never used; context returns the original config
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds `config` as a copy with `schedule_type` replaced by its display value, but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config`. The human-readable schedule_type is therefore dropped. This is a pre-existing bug that the move carried over. It should return `config`.
